why: DMIS is a named software-and-networked microscopy system that institutions could adopt, rather than a general instructional element.
name: 5G LAN-based digital microscopy interactive system (DMIS)
product_description: A 5G local-area-networked digital microscopy system integrating Panthera I microscopes, Motic Digilab 3.0, and learner devices for live image sharing, demonstrations, file transfer, and instructor–student interaction.
